I like my life very much. The pedestrian street is big and clean. After school, we play together. In fact, we go to the park by car.
We often go to the cinema together. My friend Kate is very kind. Eva drinks water every morning. Also, the castle is eight hundred years old.
Kate likes salad too. Eva wants to visit Toronto. I am happy every day.
